commitResults.messageTitle: Changed Duke to Turtley and updated banner correspondingly
Changed Duke to Turtley in README files
Changed Duke banner to Turtley banner and Duke.java to Turtley.java
Updated skill level in AGENTS.md
Added AI Declaration for ChatGPT
Updated intial code to greet and user and immediately exit
Hand-wrote code for application to echo commands by user and terminate at bye command
Use Codex to replace list() and blah() with echo(), which better reflects the intention of the exercise. Cleaned up some syntax.
Modified echo() to add() and changed the output to match
Added taskList array to keep track of tasks and allow add() to write to the array
Creates list() to read from the taskList when prompted. Added list as a switch case in prompt()
Double-checked code using codex. Made minor syntax and stylistic changes.
Used Codex to allow tasks to be marked as done using mark(). Updated prompt() to include mark()
Used Codex to allow tasks to be marked as undone using unmark(). Updated prompt() to include unmark(). Added turtles to some text.
Use Codex to create Task Class and modify Turtley.java to work with Task Objects. Remove 1 turtle.
Updated prompt() to only accept adding tasks that start with todo, deadline, or event
Edited Task and Turtley so that the text output from add() and list() are consistent with the given examples. Duration not yet implemented.
Used Codex to split up the taskType into Subclasses of Task. Added duration to the outputs of add() and list() using \by, \from, and \to as reference points.
Added test-ui skill to Codex to perform tests on the program. Edited Agent.md so that these tests are performed automatically after each code update.
Use Codex to edit and refine pre-existing exception handling to use TurtleyException. Added new exception handling for when todo event is unnamed.
Used Codex to change taskList from using array to array list, allowing the list size to change dynamically.
Use Codex to add delete() to allow deleting of tasks from task list
Added TaskType enum type so that it can be used to replace String taskType variables in tasks
Used Codex to integrate TaskType enum to replace String taskType in Task objects.
